verse.lines:
Edda tulirabagana, Olw'okwagala-okungi,
Kubanga Omwana oyo,
Ye Mukama wa byonna,
Alituusa-abaana be
Mu ggulu,babe naye.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Tetukyamulaba nate
Mu kiraalo eky'ente;
Tulimulaba mu ggulu,
Ng'atudde ne Katonda.
Naffe tulibeera-eyo,
Nga tumutendereza.
